toolTypeLegend.scorer: heuristic score against a documented rubric
toolTypeLegend.analyzer: heuristic analysis against a documented rubric

toolTypeCorrections.reason: Splits user-supplied long text into budget-valid tweets; performs no generation.

tools.name: Pinterest Board Name Generator
validation: no duplicate names in one batch
edgeCases: empty keyword -> error with guidance
non-Latin keyword -> pass through unchanged
keyword already >100 chars -> error
tools.feasibilityNote: Pure text generation from curated name-pattern bank; hard 100-char cap enforced client-side.

tools.name: Pinterest Board Description Generator
outputs: boardDescription: string (<=500 chars, keyword-rich, natural sentences)
edgeCases: empty boardName -> error
keywords longer than budget -> trim, warn
tools.feasibilityNote: Template + keyword-weaving; 500-char cap enforced client-side.

tools.name: Pinterest Bio Generator
validation: CTA kept short enough to fit budget
edgeCases: focus text >160 chars -> compress or error
no keywords -> plain bio, no filler hashtags
tools.feasibilityNote: Text-only generation; 160-char About-You cap enforced.

tools.name: Pinterest Profile Name Generator
validation: username 3-30 chars, lowercase alnum/underscore only, no spaces/symbols
edgeCases: brand >65 chars -> keyword-first truncation with warning
taken-username check impossible client-side -> label 'availability must be checked on Pinterest'
tools.feasibilityNote: Text generation + format rules; availability checking explicitly out of scope.

tools.name: Pinterest Pin Image Idea Generator
validation: each brief tied to a supported ratio (2:3, 1:1, 9:16)
text overlay suggestion kept short (<=8 words guidance)
edgeCases: abstract topic with no visual anchor -> ask for sub-topic
video format -> brief includes first-frame guidance
tools.feasibilityNote: Outputs TEXT briefs only (concept direction), never rendered images; no image-generation claim.

tools.name: Pinterest Idea Pin Script Generator
validation: each onScreenText short enough for 9:16 readability
edgeCases: pageCount >20 -> clamp with warning
topic needing outbound link -> warn: idea pins carry no outbound link
tools.feasibilityNote: Structured script text; page cap and no-outbound-link rule are static platform facts.

tools.name: Pinterest Keyword Combiner
edgeCases: single seed -> combos from modifiers only
modifier overlapping seed -> dedupe
tools.feasibilityNote: Deterministic cartesian product + dedupe; zero external data needed.

tools.name: Pinterest SEO Title Rewriter
outputs: rewrites: string[] (each <=100 chars, keyword in first 3-5 words)
edgeCases: draft already optimal -> return with 'already optimized' note
keyword >100 chars -> error
tools.feasibilityNote: Rewrite variants from title-pattern bank; 'rewriter' style but inventory type 'generator' is accurate.

tools.name: Pinterest Hashtag Generator
outputs: hashtags: string[] (specific > generic, 2-5 recommended for use)
edgeCases: overly generic topic -> steer to specific tags with note
tools.feasibilityNote: Tags drawn from in-repo curated dataset; LIVE popularity/volume cannot be checked client-side -> UI must label 'curated suggestions, not live trend data'.

tools.name: Pinterest Alt Text Generator
inputs: imageDescription (string, required: what the user sees in the image)
outputs: altText: string (<=500 chars, descriptive, 1-2 keywords woven naturally)
edgeCases: user provides only a keyword, no description -> prompt for description
description >500 chars -> compress
tools.feasibilityNote: Accessibility-framed text generation; 500-char cap enforced.

tools.name: Pinterest Pin Ratio Checker
outputs: closestFormat: enum(standard-2:3, square-1:1, idea-9:16, long-1:2.1, off-spec)
validation: non-integer dims accepted, ratio computed on rounded values
edgeCases: extreme ratios (e.g. 1:10) -> 'off-spec, will crop heavily'
square input -> 'valid but low feed visibility' note
tools.feasibilityNote: Trivial deterministic math (GCD reduction + threshold table); fully client-side.

tools.name: Pinterest Fresh Pin Checklist
outputs: checklistItems: {item, why}[] (new image per URL, unique title/description, correct 2:3 ratio, keyword coverage, no reused creative)
edgeCases: user expects guaranteed distribution boost -> disclaimer: checklist reflects creator best practice, not Pinterest's internal freshness signals
tools.feasibilityNote: Static checklist from curated best-practice bank; 'freshness' framed honestly (no claim to know Pinterest's internal detection).

tools.name: Pinterest Seasonal Content Planner
validation: events drawn from in-repo seasonal-events dataset
lead time >=4 weeks flagged (Pinterest planning behavior)
edgeCases: niche with no seasonal hooks (e.g. evergreen B2B) -> return evergreen angles with note
dataset stale -> quarterly dataset refresh scheduled
tools.feasibilityNote: Static dataset + niche-angle templates; dataset ships in-repo, review quarterly.

tools.name: Pinterest Niche Idea Generator
inputs: audience (string, optional: US/UK/CA/AU default per user rule)
edgeCases: vague interests -> ask 1 clarifying pick from list
non-visual niche -> note the handicap honestly
tools.feasibilityNote: Idea generation from niche-pattern bank; no market data claimed.

tools.name: Pinterest Content Calendar Generator
validation: pin count matches pinsPerWeek x weeks
edgeCases: pinsPerWeek >21 -> cap with note
past month selected -> error
tools.feasibilityNote: Deterministic calendar assembly from theme rotation + seasonal dataset.

tools.name: Pinterest Pin Title A/B Scorer
outputs: scores: {title, totalScore (0-100), criteria: {keywordPosition, specificity, length, actionLanguage, curiosityGap}}
validation: both titles <=100 chars (else scored with over-limit penalty + warning)
edgeCases: identical titles -> tie with note
titles in non-Latin script -> score with 'limited heuristic coverage' note
tools.feasibilityNote: Heuristic rubric only; output MUST be labeled 'heuristic estimate, not a prediction of Pinterest ranking'. No fake ML/AI claim.

tools.name: Pinterest Link-in-Bio Page Builder
outputs: htmlFile: single-file HTML (inline CSS, no external deps) for download
edgeCases: URL without scheme -> auto-prefix https:// with note
20+ links -> cap with note
tools.feasibilityNote: Generates a downloadable static HTML page client-side (Blob download); no hosting provided. Pinterest framing = pin-CTA copy + 2:3-friendly hero guidance.
tools.differentiationLocked: Keep-both vs tool-232 (Lead): 367 = Pinterest-specific link-in-bio builder. 232 = general. Distinct.

tools.name: X Bio Generator
validation: CTA + link-field reminder (URL goes in website field, not bio)
edgeCases: inputs already >160 chars -> compress with warning
tools.feasibilityNote: Text generation with 160-char cap enforced.

tools.name: X Username Generator
outputs: handles: string[] (each <=15 chars, [A-Za-z0-9_], no leading digit issues)
edgeCases: all candidates likely taken -> note: availability must be checked on X
baseName with spaces/symbols -> sanitized variants
tools.feasibilityNote: Combinatorial handle generation; availability check explicitly out of scope.

tools.name: X Tweet Idea Generator
edgeCases: topic needing >280 chars -> suggest thread tool (371) instead
tools.feasibilityNote: Tweet drafts validated against X weighted counting rules client-side.

tools.name: X Thread Idea Generator
outputs: thread: {position, text (<=280 weighted chars), role: hook|point|cta}[]
edgeCases: tweetCount >25 -> clamp with note (thread practicality)
topic too thin for N tweets -> reduce count with note
tools.feasibilityNote: Outline generation; numbering/budget enforced client-side.

tools.name: X Thread Splitter
outputs: tweets: string[] (each within 280 weighted chars incl. numbering)
validation: split on sentence/word boundaries, never mid-word
numbering marker budget reserved before splitting
edgeCases: text with very long unbreakable tokens (URLs) -> URL counted as 23, kept whole
CJK text -> each char counts 2, noted
tools.feasibilityNote: Deterministic text-splitting with X weighted counting; no generation involved. TOOLTYPE CORRECTION: inventory 'generator' -> 'splitter'.

tools.name: X Post Formatter
validation: weighted count computed per X rules
over-budget text flagged, not silently cut
edgeCases: already clean text -> return unchanged with 'no changes needed'
tools.feasibilityNote: Formatting + budget meter; fully deterministic.

tools.name: X Thread Numbering Formatter
outputs: numberedTweets: string[] (1/N markers applied, each within 280 weighted chars)
validation: renumbering after marker insertion re-validated against budget
existing numbering stripped first to avoid double markers
edgeCases: a tweet overflowing after numbering -> flagged for manual trim, not auto-cut
tools.feasibilityNote: Deterministic numbering + re-validation.

tools.name: X Hashtag Generator
outputs: usageNote: '0-2 per post recommended; more reads as spam'
edgeCases: topic with no hashtag culture -> note that hashtags add little on X
tools.feasibilityNote: Curated dataset; live trend data unavailable client-side -> labeled accordingly. Best-practice cap surfaced in UI.

tools.name: X Hook Analyzer
validation: input over 280 chars -> analyzed with over-limit warning
edgeCases: non-English hook -> analyze with 'limited heuristic coverage' note
tools.feasibilityNote: Heuristic rubric; labeled 'heuristic estimate, not a virality prediction'. No fake AI.

tools.name: X Poll Idea Generator
edgeCases: topic with >4 natural options -> pick 4, list dropped ones as note
tools.feasibilityNote: Idea generation bounded by poll spec caps.

tools.name: X Spaces Title Generator
validation: titles kept short (<=70 chars guidance, no verified platform cap)
edgeCases: no verified Spaces title limit found -> no hard cap enforced; noted as UNVERIFIED
tools.feasibilityNote: Text generation; no platform limit to enforce (flagged unverified).

tools.name: X Pinned Tweet Idea Generator
outputs: pinnedTweets: string[] (each within 280 weighted chars, CTA-led)
tools.feasibilityNote: Draft generation with budget enforcement.

tools.name: X Quote Tweet Idea Generator
validation: comment budget enforced (quoted post itself costs 0)
tools.feasibilityNote: Comment-draft generation; quoted content costs 0 chars (static fact).

tools.name: X Content Pillars Planner
edgeCases: niche too narrow for 4 pillars -> reduce with note
tools.feasibilityNote: Planning templates; no external data.

tools.name: X Banner Text Generator
outputs: safeZoneNote: keep text center-right; bottom-left overlapped by avatar on desktop
validation: copy kept short (<=60 chars guidance for legibility at 1500x500)
edgeCases: user expects image generation -> clarify: text copy only, pair with designer/canvas tool
tools.feasibilityNote: Text copy + static safe-zone guidance; no image rendering.

tools.name: X Viral Template Rewriter
inputs: template (enum of curated viral patterns: stat-hook/question-hook/hot-take/build-in-public, required)
outputs: rewrites: string[] (each within 280 weighted chars, in chosen template shape)
edgeCases: draft already matches template -> note + light polish only
tools.feasibilityNote: Static curated template patterns; UI must NOT claim live viral-data backing. Honest label: 'pattern library, not live trend data'.

tools.name: X Niche Positioning Generator
tools.feasibilityNote: Statement generation; 160-char bio-fit enforced.

tools.name: Tweet Quote Card Maker
validation: text auto-fits (font scales, min-size floor then 'text too long' error)
edgeCases: very long quote -> suggest shortening, never render illegible text
emoji in quote -> rendered via system font, noted
tools.feasibilityNote: Client-side <canvas> render + PNG download; no server, no image API.

tools.name: Facebook Bio Generator
outputs: bio: string (personal: <=101 chars; page: <=255 chars short description)
edgeCases: user unsure of mode -> default personal + show page variant as bonus
tools.feasibilityNote: Text generation with dual caps; mode disambiguation is the key edge case.

tools.name: Facebook Page Name Generator
validation: no misleading suffixes (official/page-verified style claims rejected)
edgeCases: name availability check impossible client-side -> labeled accordingly
tools.feasibilityNote: Name generation with 75-char cap.

tools.name: Facebook Group Name Generator
edgeCases: group name limit is secondary-sourced -> UI shows limit as guidance, not guarantee
tools.feasibilityNote: Text generation; 75-char cap applied with honesty note.

tools.name: Facebook Group Rules Generator
outputs: rules: {rule, why}[] (spam, self-promo, respect, off-topic, moderation)
edgeCases: no verified platform cap on rules text -> no hard cap; noted
tools.feasibilityNote: Text generation; compliance with FB policies is the admin's job -> disclaimer included.

tools.name: Facebook Post Idea Generator
outputs: postDrafts: {hook, body, cta}[] (hook front-loaded for feed truncation)
validation: key message within first ~125-150 chars (mobile truncation guidance)
technical max 63,206 noted but not targeted
edgeCases: user pastes 5000-char draft -> kept, with 'consider trimming' note
tools.feasibilityNote: Draft generation; truncation guidance is best-practice, not a hard cap.

tools.name: Facebook Reel Hook Generator
outputs: hooks: string[] (<=15 words each, first-2-seconds spoken/visual)
edgeCases: reel duration/audio specs not verified -> not claimed
tools.feasibilityNote: Hook-line generation; no unverified spec claims.

tools.name: Facebook Story Idea Generator
tools.feasibilityNote: Idea generation + static canvas guidance.

tools.name: Facebook Event Idea Generator
validation: description seed concise (event description guidance ~2000 chars, secondary)
edgeCases: event cover size has conflicting sources -> note the conflict in UI
tools.feasibilityNote: Idea generation; conflicting cover-size sources flagged honestly.

tools.name: Facebook Ad Headline Generator
outputs: headlines: string[] (each <=40 chars STRICT, benefit-led, number-when-possible)
validation: HARD cap 40 chars enforced (ad delivery truncates beyond)
edgeCases: input forces >40 chars -> compress, never emit over-cap
tools.feasibilityNote: Copy generation with strict 40-char cap; delivery/performance not claimed.

tools.name: Facebook Ad Copy Generator
validation: primary text CTA in first 125 (visible) chars
edgeCases: user wants full ad setup -> clarify: copy only, no Ads Manager integration
tools.feasibilityNote: Copy generation with visibility-window rules; no ad-buy functionality.

tools.name: Facebook Hashtag Generator
outputs: usageNote: hashtags carry low weight on Facebook; 1-3 max, never the strategy
edgeCases: user expects hashtag strategy -> honest note that keywords/audience matter more on FB
tools.feasibilityNote: Curated dataset; low efficacy disclosed honestly (no fake reach claims).

tools.name: Facebook Giveaway Idea Generator
validation: compliance checklist included (no purchase necessary, rules posted, FB promotion-policy link note)
no 'tag 50 friends' style spam mechanics suggested
edgeCases: user asks for guaranteed-viral mechanic -> decline to promise, offer best-practice instead
tools.feasibilityNote: Idea generation + compliance checklist; cannot verify policy compliance -> explicit disclaimer.

tools.name: Facebook CTA Text Generator
outputs: platformNote: Page CTA BUTTONS are a fixed Facebook list (Call Now, Shop Now...) - this tool writes in-post CTA text, not the button
edgeCases: user confuses with Page CTA button -> platformNote shown prominently
tools.feasibilityNote: In-post CTA copy; fixed button list disclosed to prevent confusion.

tools.name: Facebook Cover Text Generator
outputs: safeZoneNote per coverType (page 851x315: keep text centered, clear of edges; group 1640x856)
validation: copy short enough to read at cover scale
edgeCases: user expects image design -> clarify: text copy + layout guidance only
tools.feasibilityNote: Copy + static safe-zone guidance; no image rendering.

tools.name: Facebook Group Engagement Post Generator
edgeCases: groupType vague -> offer 4 archetype variants
tools.feasibilityNote: Template generation; posting itself is manual (no automation).
